text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: First place... I won! I did it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
All that training paid off,
and I've gotten
closer
to running the way I want!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...But I can't get complacent. I have to
strive for
even more!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You should've said something if you
were
standing there!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You scared me! I guess I was so happy I
didn't
even realize you were here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: So, uh... How'd I do today?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: So, uh... How'd I do today?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Really? I was feeling it myself, but now
that I hear
someone else say it... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm going to keep this up for
my next
race!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean you have even greater

expectations for me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You're right... I want to keep reaching
for greater
heights too!
